parameters.query:
SELECT *
FROM candidatos
WHERE estado IN ('NUEVO', 'INTERESADO')
AND ultima_interaccion < (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes')
AND COALESCE(privacidad_aceptada, false) = false
AND COALESCE(vacante_interes, '') = ''
AND COALESCE(fecha_entrevista, '') = '';
